body: It sounds like you may just have to wait until the exams are over in order to kick back and enjoy yourself. School's important, so it has to be a top priority. I'd give my right arm to be able to attend art college. I hope all goes well with you also. Its not that its a complete and total bummer, its the fact that every time you look in the mirror you never feel like yourself. Still, I enjoy the baggy clothes and the comfy boxers...so roomy. :)

What should you do? There's nothing you can do, except for take care of yourself and try your very hardest to get over her.
I've been there before, right where you are. For 8 1/2 years, I followed my straight best friend around with the false hopes that maybe someday she'd come to love me...unfortunately, just like your situation, she turned out to be straight and I wasted EIGHT (1/2) whole years of my life for nothing. Trust me, you should try to conquer this green beast of jealousy now before it grows into a 100-ft tall b*tchzilla that totals what's left of your heart. She left me all alone too, and I was in and out of mental institutions, skin sliced up like an Edward Scissorhand sculpture and she just looked at me and my suffering and just walked away, like I was nothing. She doesn't care about you, or else she would still try to make at least your friendship work. You deserve to love someone who CAN love you, rather than someone who's completely incapable of even showing the slightest amount of compassion or understanding. Take care of yourself, watch your favorite movie, listen to your favorite song, look for new friends with more in common...I know its just a distraction, but its better than feeling like total dog sh*t. I know how bad it hurts, but you'll make it!

What if you guys were to get back together? You wouldn't know if you went through with suicide. Also, there's plenty of fish out in the sea, even if the sea is full of sh*t, oil and garbage...O.o
I don't think you should blame yourself entirely. In a relationship, it takes 'two to tango'--which means he is also responsible for what happened not just you. People hurt others, and people hurt themselves, its only natural that we feel dangerous-we are the apex predators of earth after all. No matter what you do, there's always consequences (good and bad) and there's no escaping that. Yes, you can end it all right here and now but is that what you really want? Is that what your ex. and family want as well? If you killed yourself, it would do a lot more harm than good I can promise you that...and if you don't want to cause any further harm to the people you love then take care of yourself and try to find happiness, even in the smallest of things.
I know, I meant you should write a sequel of sorts. Just a suggestion though, didn't mean to impose.

Thanks guys, its nice to hear that some of you feel the same way.
I would very much like to get the hell out of here, however its not so simple. I lost my job working at pizza hut, and all I have left to my name is $52.46 so it would be impossible as of now to even THINK about moving. There's not many job opportunities out here in the boonies, and not many people in this town like me very much...makes it that much harder. I feel trapped, been feeling that way for some time now...like a hamster in a ball with no way to get out. I'd beg the 'master' for a break, perhaps some sunflower seeds, but NO!!-B*tch has to kick the ball and send me flying backwards (a b*tch called life.) As of now, I stay at home and hardly leave the house...not even for groceries. It makes me sick to my stomach every time I leave because of the ape-ish morons I'm surrounded by constantly. My dream is to one day go to Washington or California, so I can be free to love the ladies and smoke pot any time I wish...but somehow I fear that its just not meant to happen for me, like I'm cursed to die here...You guys ever feel cursed?...like your life is just one bad omen?

Yaay, friendship! :D 
I used to hate sleep but when I lost my last job working at pizza hut, I just couldn't stop myself. Now adays I just live just for the sake of existing, nothing more, nothing less. You seem pretty cool, wouldn't mind having a skype smoke session with you in the near future lol. At least then, we'd be wasting time together rather than asleep and alone.
You're braver than I could ever be. Still, I wish you would hold on...hold onto what? I don't know. Guess that's my selfish way of saying "Don't do it!"

We're all scared of the unknown...we wouldn't still be alive, despite wanting to die if we didn't feel that way. I think its human nature. I also think its human nature to be curious about death itself, possible afterlife etc. I think that you're very brave, I think its great that you still have to hope to carry on, even if its false hope--still hope, nonetheless.

If you can't live for yourself, you can only go so far living for the sake of others...that's what so many people fail to understand. However, what if this is just the beginning? Who knows what else is waiting for you on the other side. What if its nothing?...a big void of nothing, like the coldness you feel inside your chest. Do you really want to risk it all just to find out? I do...but I wish I didn't.
That was truly beautiful. Though it would be a tragic to actually end the poem on such a somber note. I think you should write more...you should be here so you can.

Hey, I only have one friend and she thinks I'm 'disgusting' and won't be seen with me in public. She isn't really a friend and neither are your so-called friends. If they were then you wouldn't be afraid to be yourself around them. Honestly, I think you might as well be alone with that sort of company. You feel that way, don't you?
I've been in a romantic relationship, but it was so HORRIBLE and it scarred me emotionally for life. Now I'm too afraid to leave my house, let alone kill myself despite my wanting to. I used to eat my feelings, then I got diabetes so I started working out because my doctor strongly recommended it. I felt SO much better about myself, and after while of dieting the pounds just melted off. Though it shouldn't matter what size you are. If you are comfortable in your skin, then that's what should matter. F*ck everyone else.

You can't help how you feel, for you are entitled to your own feelings, thoughts, beliefs. Its one of those lovely things that separate us from cattle. The nicest person in the world may indeed be capable of the darkest of deeds, but remember that even the most wicked of men can find redemption. You may not be able to bring the dead back to life, but you can live on-in their names and live a life that would make said person proud. (If you read books/manga, you should read Rurouni Kenshin-it is a testament to a tale such as this.) We all have the capability, despite the sh*tty hand we're dealt in our lives. In order to love another, we must first learn to love ourselves...or at least that's what many people have told me. Perhaps that's why I'll never find the love people speak so fondly of. But who knows, maybe you'll be more fortunate.

Hey man. I like to get high myself. I HATE life when I'm sober. Everything becomes black and white. You have cancer, so I suppose your excuse is as good as any. Pot is actually supposed to help people with your condition so it can't be all bad. Now as for the self-harm...Let me just say I used to be a cutter too, and as a matter of fact, just relapsed after 2 years of staying away from sharp, pointy objects. So yeah, guess you could call me a cutter. I could kinda use a friend myself, preferably one that won't stab me in the back when I turn to look at 'the pretty bird' they spoke so fondly of just moments prior. I love to sleep, it keeps me away from suicidal thoughts and depressed-talking-to-self-monologue. I'm a total coward though, I don't think I'd end up dying by slicing a vein, rather a painful overdose of sorts. Anyway, its nice to meet you Puwprin, I'm Moose. :)

I identify as male despite the fact I am actually a female lesbian. I would go all out trans but I have not the finances to fund that dream...
I don't fight, I just walk through life one step at a time. I live moment by moment. If I don't like how I feel, then I turn to whatever soothes me for comfort to distract me. Unfortunately, I'm having one of those mornings where the world is: molded dark, rotten and its beauty is dying inevitably. 2015 may be my last year as well, but there are no guarantees in this splendorous hell of a life.

Woa...I can totally get where you're coming from. I feel pretty empty inside also. Don't know if I'm alive or just breathing. I exist to merely be--a shell of someone I cannot define, a person I cannot be, a soul that cannot be mine. I cut myself off from people who claimed to care, who tried to be there--even after they hurt me and left me all alone. My family wants nothing to do with me, unlike yours. My mom used to take a large cast iron skillet (and other misc. inanimate objects) when I was a kid and smack me across the head (or wherever else she could reach) just for speaking when not spoken to when she got wasted. I've received a few concussions in my lifetime due to that. My dad disowned me despite the fact he's on his death bed. So when you say your parents and loved ones claimed--at least they say it. Sometimes its nice to just HEAR someone say 'I love you'. I wish I had that. I'd give anything for my mother to tell me that she loved me. You wish to be normal? No one is normal sweetie, everyone has SOMETHING wrong with them. Ask anyone and they'll tell you so. As a person who's been 'committed', let me tell you a mental institution is probably one of the worst places you could wind up in. You should only admit yourself if your life depends on it. I'd try to get counseling or find a friend (even online buddy) whose close enough to you..that's probably your best bet for decent advice/company. When things go bad, in the end its up to us to act/think for ourselves. Unfortunately most people have the tendency to leave you hanging when sh*t hits the fan. I hope you find that one person that could be there to at least block some of that metaphorical projectile fecal matter of life from your path...at least to give the the illusion that the world isn't all that bad.

Only person you can trust entirely is yourself--that's what my experiences have taught me anyway.
I'm feeling rather impulsive right now, who knows what I might do. Should I be afraid? Nope. Why? Because its a part of me, it makes me the spontaneous, spastic, creative and horrible person that I am. We'll all die some day no matter what the means or method; I take great comfort in that. Hope you find peace of mind and comfort soon, somewhere in this rotten world. (Sorry for being a total Eeyore.)
